blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: On-policy self-distillation provides dense supervision for reasoning models via a privileged self-teacher. However, this supervision reflects local token preferences rather than the expected return of an unguided student continuation. Recent methods combine this signal with GRPO. They use GRPO for update directions and the teacher for signal scaling. However, we demonstrate a more effective integration within PPO. Specifically, we identify complementary positional dynamics: privileged information enhances a critic's value-prediction accuracy toward the response's end, whereas self-teacher guidance is strong initially, drops mid-generation, and rebounds finally. These insights motivate Value-Augmented Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (VASPO), wherein a self-teacher and critic evaluate identical privileged information at student-generated prefixes. The critic computes token-level PPO advantages from predicted continuation returns, while the self-teacher modulates selected positive advantages via bounded probability ratios. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, VASPO improves mean accuracy over PPO by 2.59 and 1.81 percentage points on Qwen3-4B and OLMo3-7B variants, respectively, and achieves the highest mean accuracy among evaluated methods on Knights and Knaves. Our code is available at https://github.com/cii030/VASPO.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Training reasoning models from verified final answers requires assigning
credit to intermediate decisions. Reinforcement learning with verifiable
rewards (RLVR) supplies a reliable outcome but does not identify which
tokens contributed to it ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ) . Group Relative
Policy Optimization (GRPO) compares several responses to the same problem
and broadcasts each response’s advantage across its tokens ( Shao et al., 2024 ) .
Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) instead learns a value model, or critic,
to turn the outcome into advantages ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) . Both approaches
must learn from a reward that arrives only after the response is complete.

blocks.en:
On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) supplies a denser, token-level signal at
student-generated prefixes. The self-teacher reads privileged
information, such as a worked solution or a ground-truth answer, and scores the sampled tokens ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . This guidance can distinguish tokens within a response,
but its preferences conditioned on privileged information are not
verifier-grounded measures of the student’s eventual success. Privileged
context can shift the signal toward style rather than task content ( Pan et al., 2026 ) , suppress deliberation in
reasoning models ( Kaur et al., 2026 ) , or yield unreliable targets at
some prefixes ( Liu et al., 2026a ) . These observations motivate
combining token guidance with outcome feedback while measuring when that
guidance is useful.

blocks.en:
Prior work has demonstrated the effectiveness of providing reference answers as input to the critic ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) .
Teacher preferences and continuation values serve fundamentally distinct roles at the same student prefix. While the teacher evaluates immediate token choices using privileged information, the critic predicts the expected success rate of the student’s unguided continuation. Thus, a token highly rated by the privileged teacher does not guarantee that the student can successfully navigate the remaining complex steps independently. We posit that a reference solution helps the critic accurately align incomplete responses, improving PPO value estimation beyond standard token-level supervision by bridging the gap between local step correctness and global trajectory success.

blocks.en: Therefore, we introduce Value-Augmented Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (VASPO) to leverage shared privileged information for both signals (Figure 1 ). In this framework, the actor generates responses conditioned solely on the standard problem prompt. Concurrently, a self-teacher and a critic access the fixed privileged information at the student’s sampled prefixes. The critic’s value estimates and verifier rewards are used to compute GAE advantages, while clipped teacher–student probability ratios scale selected positive advantages prior to the PPO update. This design effectively integrates privileged information into both the token-guidance and value-estimation paths, all while preserving an autonomous student continuation as the critic’s true prediction target.

blocks.en:
We evaluate VASPO on mathematical reasoning with Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 and OLMo3-7B-Instruct-DPO and on
Knights and Knaves with Qwen3 only. Across these settings, VASPO achieves higher
average accuracy than the evaluated baselines. Further controlled
evaluations examine the contribution of privileged value estimation
and the roles of the two signals across response positions. Our contributions are threefold: • We characterize the positional profiles of privileged information:
critic prediction benefits grow toward the end, while self-teacher
divergence is high early, lower in the middle, and rebounds at the end. • We propose VASPO, which shares privileged information between a
self-teacher and a critic to combine token guidance with
continuation-value estimation. Critic-derived PPO advantages are
modulated by bounded teacher preferences, while the actor remains
prompt-only. • We demonstrate improved mathematical and logical reasoning.
Across six mathematical benchmarks, VASPO improves the mean score over
PPO by 2.59 percentage points on Qwen3 and 1.81 points on OLMo3. On
Knights and Knaves with Qwen3, it also achieves the highest average accuracy
among the evaluated methods.

blocks.en: 2 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 2 序言

blocks.en: In this section, we review the two training paradigms that form the basis of our formulation. RLVR provides an outcome-grounded policy-gradient objective, while OPSD offers a privileged token-level signal on the same on-policy prefixes. Finally, we examine how the contribution of privileged information to these two signals evolves across different stages of a generated response.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们回顾构成我们案文基础的两个培训模式。 RLVR提供了一个基于结果的政策分级目标,而OPSD则在同一政策前缀上提供特权的符号级信号. 最后,我们审查特殊信息对这两个信号的贡献如何在产生反应的不同阶段演变。

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview of VASPO
blocks.zh: 3.1 VASPO概览

blocks.en: VASPO leverages shared privileged information for both value estimation and self-distillation, while ensuring the student model operates solely on the standard prompt during training and inference. As illustrated in Figure 3 , the framework retains the clipped actor update of PPO but introduces two privileged readers with distinct roles. The privileged critic estimates the expected return of an autonomous student continuation, supplying the values required to compute token-level GAE advantages. Concurrently, the self-teacher evaluates the student’s sampled tokens using the same privileged context; its preferences are transformed into bounded coefficients that scale selected positive advantages. This privileged information is established prior to rollout and accessed by both readers at identical student-generated prefixes. The remainder of this section is organized as follows: Section 3.2 formalizes the shared privileged information and student rollouts, Section 3.3 details the privileged value estimation, and Section 3.4 presents the teacher-guided reweighting alongside the actor update. Algorithm 1 summarizes the complete VASPO training procedure.
blocks.zh: VASPO发挥杠杆作用,共享价值估计和自我消化的特权信息,同时确保学生模式在培训和推论期间完全按标准即时运行。 如图3所示,框架保留了PPO的剪接角色更新,但引入了两个具有特殊角色的特权读者. 特权评论家估计自主学生续作的预期回报,提供了计算符号级GAE优势所需的价值. 同时,自学老师也使用同样的特权背景来评价学生的样本代币;其偏好被转换为限制系数,以衡量选定的积极优势。 这种特权信息在推出之前就已经建立,并且由两个读者在学生生成的相同前缀上访问. 本节其余部分的编排如下:第3.2节将共享的特权信息和学生推广正式化;第3.3节详细介绍了特权价值估计;第3.4节介绍了教师指导的再加权与演员最新情况。 算法一总结了完整的VASPO训练程序.

blocks.en: Removing the critic pre-update incurs a consistent accuracy drop across all mathematical benchmarks and KK role groups (Table 3 ). Because self-teacher advantage modulation can amplify actor updates, it risks exacerbating the distribution shift between the evolving policy and a critic fitted to outdated rollouts. Updating the critic on the latest actor trajectories prior to computing advantages enables it to align with the current policy before the subsequent actor update. This timely adaptation enhances value-prediction accuracy and yields more reliable token-level credit, effectively explaining the observed performance gains.
blocks.zh: 取消评论员更新前,所有数学基准和KK角色组的准确度都持续下降(表3)。 由于自我教师优势调制可以扩大行为者更新,它有可能加剧不断演变的政策与适合过时推出的批评者之间的分配转移。 在计算优势之前向评论家更新最新的演员轨迹,使其能够在之后的演员更新前与当前政策相配合. 这种及时的调整提高了价值预测的准确性并产生了更可靠的象征性信用,有效地解释了观察到的业绩收益。

blocks.en: Applying global whitening after teacher modulation degrades performance across all mathematical benchmarks and KK role groups (Table 3 ). Although strictly positive teacher weights preserve the signs of the raw advantages, the subsequent subtraction of a batch-wide mean can inadvertently invert the signs of some fused advantages. Consequently, tokens initially encouraged by the outcome-grounded signal might receive penalizing updates, or vice versa, severely distorting the intended optimization directions. This phenomenon accounts for the observed degradation and strongly advocates for utilizing the fused advantages without any subsequent global whitening.
blocks.zh: 在教师调制后应用全球白化,会降低所有数学基准和KK角色组的性能(表3). 虽然严格正面的师资权重保留了原始优势的征兆,但随后对分批量的减值会无意中颠倒一些被熔化优势的征兆. 因此,最初由基于结果的信号所鼓励的标志可能会受到惩罚,反之亦然,会严重扭曲预期的优化方向。 这种现象造成观察到的退化,并强烈主张利用被熔化的优势,而不必再有任何全球白化。

blocks.zh: 4.4 分析

blocks.en: Conditioning on reference solutions improves value prediction point estimates but does not aid calibration (Figure 9 ). Evaluated on fixed continuations from a frozen Qwen3 actor, the privileged solution critic yields the highest explained variance and lowest Brier error across the three checkpoints, whereas the baseline critic maintains the lowest ECE. The point-estimate rankings alone do not establish a strict overall advantage.
blocks.zh: 对参考解决方案的附加条件可以改善价值预测点估计,但不能帮助校正(图9)。 根据对被冻结的Quen3行为体的固定续作的评估,特权解决方案评论家得出了三个检查站之间解释得最高的差异和最低的布赖尔误差,而基线评论家则保持了最低的欧洲经委会。 点估计排名单靠点估计不能确立严格的整体优势.

blocks.en: The critic’s benefit varies significantly by prefix position and source-response correctness. Aggregate diagnostics indicate that solution conditioning degrades accuracy at early prefixes but improves it at late prefixes, with mixed results in the middle. Paired positional contrasts confirm this trend, highlighting that late-stage gains are largest for incorrect source responses. While length controls validate this pattern for medium and long responses, the late gain remains uncertain in the long-response group (Appendix G.3 ). Conversely, the self-teacher follows a different trajectory: its divergence from the baseline actor is high initially, falls through the middle, and rebounds at the final position (Figure 2 ). These complementary signal profiles motivate employing the two readers for distinct roles in the update.
blocks.zh: 批评者的利益因前缀位置和源响应正确性而有很大差异. 综合诊断表明,溶液调节在早期前缀会降解精度,但在后缀会改进精度,中间结果有好有坏. 立场对比表明这一趋势,强调晚期收益对不正确的来源反应最大。 虽然长度控制验证了中长期反应的这种模式,但在长期反应组(附录G.3.)中,延迟收益仍然不确定。 相反,自学者走的是不同的轨迹:其与基线角色的分差最初很高,从中间掉入,到最后位置反弹(图2)。 这些互补的信号简介促使两个读者在更新过程中发挥不同的作用。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented VASPO, a PPO framework leveraging shared reference solutions for continuation-value estimation and token guidance. By combining privileged critic credit and bounded self-teacher modulation, VASPO trains actors using solely standard prompts. Empirically, it achieves top average accuracy across Qwen3 and OLMo3 mathematical and logical reasoning benchmarks. Analyses show privileged conditioning trades higher early-prefix error and worse calibration for improved late-prefix value prediction. Lastly, ablations confirm that full solution derivations and selective, moderate teacher modulation are crucial.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了VASPO,这是一个PPO框架,利用共享的参考解决方案进行持续价值估计和象征性指导。 VASPO通过将特权批评者信用和限定的自教调制相结合,培训演员使用完全标准的提示. 从经验上讲,它在Quen3和OLMo3数学和逻辑推理基准上实现了最高平均精度. 分析显示特权条件交易更早前缀错误和更差的校正,用于改进后缀值预测. 最后,杂乱无章地证实,充分的解决办法以及选择性、温和的教师调制至关重要。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Extending VASPO to interactive tasks requires careful consideration of when newly observed information becomes available to the value estimator. Specifically, under the current protocol, environmental feedback obtained at the completion of a response cannot be retroactively used as privileged context for earlier prefixes of that same trajectory.
blocks.zh: 将VASPO扩展至交互式任务,需要仔细考虑新观察到的信息何时提供给价值估计器。 具体地说,根据目前的协议,在答复完成后获得的环境反馈不能追溯性地用作同一轨迹前缀的特权上下文。

blocks.en: Furthermore, the framework’s efficacy is constrained by evidence quality and computational overhead. Privileged reference solutions, even when yielding a verified final answer, may still harbor flawed intermediate reasoning steps that could introduce noisy supervision. Additionally, conditioning the readers on full solutions expands the context window for both the teacher and the critic, thereby increasing training costs.
blocks.zh: 此外,框架的效能受到证据质量和计算间接费用的限制。 专有的参考解决办法,即使在得出经核实的最后答案时,仍可能隐藏有缺陷的中间推理步骤,可能引入吵闹的监督。 此外,为读者提供完整的解决方案可以扩大教师和评论家的背景窗口,从而增加培训费用。

blocks.en: Finally, VASPO is currently designed for single-turn generation. Its application to multi-turn dialogue—where conversational history and available privileged evidence dynamically evolve across successive turns—remains an open direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 最后,VASPO目前设计为单回合生成. 它在多回合对话中的应用——其中对话历史和现有的特权证据在接连不断地演变——仍然是未来工作的开放方向。

blocks.en: B.2 On-Policy Distillation and Self-Teaching
blocks.zh: B.2 政策分解和自学

blocks.en:
On-policy distillation supplies teacher feedback on the states that the
student actually visits. GKD trains on student-generated sequences and
studies several distribution-matching objectives ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ) ,
while MiniLLM uses a reverse-KL objective optimized through policy gradients ( Gu et al., 2024 ) . More recent work also considers objectives that relax
strict imitation: ExOPD scales the teacher-derived implicit reward within a
KL-constrained formulation ( Yang et al., 2026b ) . These methods establish
student-generated prefixes as the interface for dense teacher supervision.

blocks.en:
Self-distillation obtains a better-informed teacher by changing its context
rather than requiring a separate, larger model. Retrieval-augmented
generation conditions a model on external evidence in a similar spirit:
Stable-RAG shows that permuting the retrieved clues can by itself induce
hallucinations ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , while compact clue selection reduces
such evidence to an informative subset for efficient reasoning ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) . This use of training-only
context connects self-teaching to learning using privileged information and
generalized distillation ( Vapnik and Vashist, 2009 ; Lopez-Paz et al., 2016 ) . OPSD
conditions a detached self-teacher on worked solutions and matches its
distributions along clean student rollouts ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . SDPO
constructs self-teaching contexts from rich environment feedback and
successful attempts, allowing the policy to learn from information revealed
during interaction ( Hübotter et al., 2026 ) . Studies of privileged OP(S)D identify
failure modes for thinking models, instance-specific privileged information,
and unreliable teacher targets at some student prefixes ( Kaur et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) . These
findings concern the teacher signal and its downstream effect on the actor.
VASPO uses the privileged information for sampled-token assessment and
additionally tests its effect on continuation-value estimation. This second
role constrains evidence timing: the shared bank is fixed before rollout,
whereas feedback from the current completed response can inform a
retrospective teacher without being an admissible input to VASPO’s critic for
that same response.

blocks.en: B.3 Combining Distillation with Verifiable Rewards
blocks.zh: B.3 将蒸馏与可核实的奖励相结合

blocks.en:
Several methods combine dense distillation with outcome optimization through
an additive objective or advantage. MiMo-V2-Flash adds teacher–student
log-probability gaps to outcome-derived advantages in its multi-teacher
distillation pipeline ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) . SDPG combines a verifier-based
policy-gradient objective with an exact full-vocabulary self-distillation
loss and reference-policy KL regularization ( Liu et al., 2026b ) .
SAF-OPD studies the relative magnitude and training schedule of the two
signals, using sparsification and bounded compression together with warm-up
and annealing for the external-teacher OPD branch ( Ding et al., 2026 ) .
These designs show that the granularity, scale, and timing of teacher
supervision are separate choices in the fusion interface.

blocks.en:
Other methods select where to apply each signal. Sample-Routed Policy
Optimization (SRPO) routes failed responses with available teacher
information to self-distillation and the remaining responses to GRPO ( Li et al., 2026 ) .
Reward-Gated OPD instead retains trajectories for distillation according to
agreement between the verifier-derived advantage and a sequence-level
teacher–student likelihood gap ( Akhondzadeh et al., 2026 ) . Its verifier thus
controls a distillation gate, rather than contributing an additive reward
term. VASPO uses a learned prefix value to construct its advantage and
applies teacher modulation within that actor–critic update.

blocks.en:
The closest group-relative interfaces use the teacher to refine
verifier-grounded credit. Self-Distilled RLVR (RLSD) preserves the sign of the
outcome advantage while a detached teacher–student evidence ratio changes
token-level update magnitudes ( Yang et al., 2026a ) . RLCSD
contrasts correct and incorrect privileged contexts to suppress
correctness-independent style shifts in the teacher signal ( Pan et al., 2026 ) . SSPO applies
teacher–student disagreement as step-level advantage weights on incorrect
deep-search trajectories ( Wu et al., 2026b ) . Their group-relative outcome
advantages are shared across positions before teacher modulation; they do not
learn a value conditioned on privileged information for each student prefix.
VASPO uses the privileged information in a learned PPO critic as well as the
teacher, so its outcome-grounded advantages can vary across prefixes before
modulation. The bounded fusion preserves the sign of the raw privileged-critic
advantage (Section 3.4 ).

blocks.en:
For each task and policy backbone, we use the initial policy checkpoint
to sample eight responses per training prompt. The actor observes only the
standard problem prompt, without the privileged solution or answer.
Each response receives a binary correctness label from the task verifier
described in Appendix D.2 . We upsample incorrect
response trajectories to obtain an approximately balanced ratio of correct
and incorrect examples. The same sampled trajectories and return labels
are used to pretrain the clean and privileged critic variants.

blocks.en:
Each critic is initialized from its corresponding policy backbone with a
scalar value head and pretrained for two epochs before RL, following the
value-pretraining protocol of VAPO ( Yue et al., 2025 ) . Pretraining minimizes
the mean squared error between each token-level prediction and the
response’s terminal verifier return. With γ = 1 \gamma=1 , every valid
response-token state has the same binary target. The clean critic reads
the prompt and preceding response tokens; the privileged critic additionally
reads the fixed dataset solution and answer. Neither critic observes the
current token or subsequent response tokens. PPO and the critic-based
reader ablations use the same initialization, pretraining trajectories,
targets, and epoch count; the input conditioning changes with the ablation.
Offline pretraining initializes the critic, while the per-rollout
pre-update in Appendix F adapts it during RL.
